column1: # per suite: wall s, CPU s (user + sys) of one run on mgr-ran (i7-3770K, 4 cores / 8 threads), and the shards
# check.sh runs it as (bench/suites.py; at most the pool width). Measured 2026-11-12 19:54 on the merged tree
# (37.5.0, 59 suites), pool 8, load 1.3, from that run's out/check-times.tsv. Order: longest first.
# test_clipwin: the sum of its six shards (each replays what it reads of the others); a whole run is about 35 min.
# A suite missing here is queued as a 2-minute job: test_savexml (11 min) ran last that way and the check took 20 min.
